conclusion: GitHub-hosted windows-latest CAN load a kernel driver with real SPC SHA-1 signing (no test-signing reboot needed); SHA-256 SPC signing is broken.

signing_recipe.verify: signtool verify /kp <file> -> pass (0x80096005 before the TSA root is trusted)
signing_recipe.sha256: spcsign SHA-256 path produces TRUST_E_BAD_DIGEST (0x80096010) - use --sha1 only

independent_probe.notes: A full-featured probe driver (device + IOCTL) hung the runner VM at sc start; minimal DriverEntry-only driver is safe. Always guard sc start with a process timeout.

drv_lite.result: green: SPC SHA-1 + trust imports, /kp verified, sc start STATE 4 RUNNING, kernel read 4d 5a verified

kchannel.result: driver reached STATE 4 RUNNING on the hosted runner; job failed only because kchannel-ctl refuses to run outside a bvmenv guest (host-safety guard) - allow it when GITHUB_ACTIONS=true

policy: blook-drv hypervisor remains VM-only (needs VT-x/nested virt); user-mode kernel-load smoke tests are CI-viable.
